# StayWise

> > StayWise is a free safety education library powered by UK emergency services (Fire, Police, Ambulance, Coastguard, RNLI) delivering curriculum-mapped and age-segmented prevention resources.

StayWise provides comprehensive safety education content designed for educators, emergency service practitioners, and young people. The platform offers curriculum-aligned lessons, interactive activities, professional training resources, and community safety campaigns backed by statutory guidance and emergency services partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Safety Education
- Emergency Services
- Blue Light Services
- Community Safety
- Prevention Education
- Fire Safety
- Youth Safety
- Curriculum Resources
- Professional Training
- Statutory Requirements
- Activity Centre
- Home Educators
- PSHE
- Resource Library
- Safety Practitioners

## Core Portals

- [Home](https://staywise.co.uk): StayWise homepage: free safety education library from UK emergency services
- [Teachers & Home Educators](https://staywise.co.uk/teachers): Educator portal with English National Curriculum-mapped safety lessons
- [Activity Centre](https://staywise.co.uk/public): Activity Centre: age-segmented safety resources for primary and secondary
- [Blue Light Users](https://staywise.co.uk/blue-light-users): Blue light services portal for Fire, Police, Ambulance, Coastguard practitioners
- [About StayWise](https://staywise.co.uk/about): About StayWise: emergency services partnership for youth safety education

## Student Resources

- [Primary Resources](https://staywise.co.uk/public/primary): Interactive primary school games and activities from emergency services
- [Secondary Resources](https://staywise.co.uk/public/secondary): Secondary school videos and infographics on fire safety and hazard awareness
